scope: One workspace, three current snapshot input routes, optional Unity; no new experiment or product command.

stages.name: Choose or resume work
stages.preconditions: Need independent execution; retain exact request identity.
stages.work: Choose direct work or reuse/create one task.
stages.completion: No lifecycle side effect from choosing a route.
stages.recovery: Unknown owner is not permission to make a replacement task.

stages.name: Prepare shared Library/project basis
stages.preconditions: Explicit transition; exact original Editor saved/stopped; supported same-volume NTFS.
stages.work: Hash/manifest/proof; move basis; admit and mount original private view.
stages.completion: Ready basis record and original view ownership observed.
stages.costs: Full input hashing, per-file handles, proof writes, provider launch
stages.recovery: Resume same prepare intent; ambiguous moves preserve both paths.

stages.name: Persist workspace request
stages.work: Normalize identity, derive ID/digest, compare or publish v2 create intent.
stages.completion: Durably published task record; no new task from a completed ID.
stages.costs: Lock wait, path validation, atomic JSON publication
stages.recovery: Mismatch refuses; same request resumes effects.

stages.name: Preflight, capture, register
stages.frequency: initial task preparation or incomplete step
stages.preconditions: Project source guard and fixed basis; existing task identity.
stages.work: Source preflight; fixed receipt/ref/dependency; owned registration without full checkout.
stages.completion: source-checked, capture-intent, captured, registration-intent, registered records.
stages.recovery: Resume recorded step; preserve external/source mismatch.

stages.name: Connect, replay, mount
stages.preconditions: Exact read access/owner/basis; no owned app clients on missing-provider reconnect.
stages.work: Own provider process, admit source, replay journal, mount with 8 dispatch threads. Reuse launch observations under client.lock; skip only publication-excluded absence waits; ordinary observers retain grace and unresolved-launch checks. A child may finish a prior intent receipt during observation; an unresolved intent remains uncertain and requires the same-request reobservation, never a replacement launch.
stages.completion: Observed exact provider identity and mounted path; ready is not compile proof.
stages.costs: Launch, full admission, replay, handles/cache initialization
stages.recovery: No mutable-source copy fallback; uncertain owner preserved.

stages.name: Attach and prove baseline
stages.preconditions: Live fixed mount and owned source registration.
stages.work: Refresh Git index with eligible joined read-ahead or scan file manifests; prove clean base. None full hashes use up to eight workers; mounted Plastic source scans remain serial; one-use initial inspection proof revalidates metadata/membership and complete generation barriers for the same editorless response. Mounted Plastic scans remain serial to preserve its single-revision proof/stream locality. Opt-in Git diagnostics record reader/cache/proof counters and bounded overlapping attach-attempt intervals with running/succeeded/failed/cancelled outcomes; they do not replace content proofs or change reader/cache budgets.
stages.costs: Index/stat/hash, first blob proofs, manifest traversal
stages.recovery: Drain refresh/read-ahead failures; existing index lock respected.

stages.name: Start owned Editor
stages.frequency: optional initial start or stop/start before collection
stages.preconditions: Live mounted task; no collected result; exact owned process identity.
stages.work: Resolve Unity, owned bridge/one-time cache handling, launch receipt, heartbeat observation. Separate read-only development before-start/live capture verifies exact identities and retains bounded selected Bee artifacts/logs/provider observations; it does not launch/stop Unity or inject a profiler.
stages.completion: Launch intent/receipt; heartbeat readiness is observational.
stages.costs: Unity imports, assembly work, reload, launch and polling
stages.recovery: Uncertain launch preserves intent; no duplicate automatic launch. Capture failures retain partial evidence without a successful capture marker; before/live intervals are caller-dispatched, not an automatic startup stopwatch or compile proof.

stages.name: Edit, compile, validate
stages.entry: edit returned data.workspace.path; exact-path external tool operations
stages.preconditions: Correct returned path and Editor PID/start; source/Library conditions retained for comparison.
stages.work: Edit; refresh; await compile/import/reload; inspect results; repeat.
stages.completion: Source write ACK follows W10; compilation success is externally assessed.
stages.costs: Actual workload, I/O, Unity compute, external connection/polling
stages.recovery: Timed-out external write is not blindly retried; use exact identity.

stages.name: Read base/private/hole ranges
stages.frequency: nested within filesystem reads across stages
stages.preconditions: Pinned reader lifetime, current identity/integrity, nonpoisoned store.
stages.work: Resolve ranges; read private bytes, immutable basis or zeros; finish proofs/lifetime.
stages.completion: No new source result or mutation.
stages.costs: Requested bytes versus whole-object decode/proof and physical device reads
stages.recovery: Read failure/close drains; cache hits do not bypass identity checks.

stages.name: Write and flush
stages.preconditions: Ordered live callbacks, bounded native buffers, mutation/store gates.
stages.work: Queue writes; compare private range; serialize metadata/raw payload/checksum; append; flush before ACK. Opt-in bounded telemetry distinguishes requested/effective/staged/changed bytes, callback effect completion versus return, queue high-water, gate waits, batch/chunk/split reasons and Runtime store-interval deltas without ingress I/O or retained payload. Adopted MX08A combines one Overwrite resize and metadata through SetLengthAndMetadata: one final SJR2 entry on resize, zero/one metadata commit at unchanged length; SJL4 retains existing separate durable capsules. No mixed mutation queue, new worker or format.
stages.completion: At most 64 ranges/16MiB per submitted batch; B10 may add barriers and SJL4 retains per-write barriers. Explicit SJR2 flush reuses only the same unchanged proven durable handle.
stages.costs: Queue/gate wait, comparison, preparation, append, physical flush, metadata commits
stages.recovery: Uncertain writes poison; unacknowledged prefix can replay; no batch rollback or early ACK.

stages.name: Checkpoint bounded journal state
stages.preconditions: Bounded mode; suffix/frame/budget capacity trigger; sufficient temporary space.
stages.work: Flush pending; size; full seals/state proofs; raw state candidate; flush/replay; replace; reopen/reprove; reclaim previous.
stages.completion: Durable generation intent and verified current state; next mutation still needs ACK barrier.
stages.costs: Live state rewrite, hashing, replay, replacement, temporary overlap
stages.recovery: Recover same generation; preserve corrupt/unknown state; not source checkpoint.

stages.name: Stop Editor and drain
stages.preconditions: Exact owned process/group and normal-stop token.
stages.work: Wait for nonbusy safe bridge stop, normal exit and child/resource zero; owned bridge cleanup for collection.
stages.completion: Ownership-verified zero process/Working Set/Private Bytes before stable source collection.
stages.costs: Busy waits, normal Unity shutdown, children and handles
stages.recovery: Dirty scenes/Play/timeouts preserve; no force-kill authority.

stages.name: Preserve independent source result
stages.preconditions: Task lock, stopped owned clients, stable journal, allowed source state.
stages.work: Pre-seal; Git commit/ref or one file-source scan plus full baseline/result preservation; up to eight local payload/proof workers, serial Plastic revision acquisition; verification; post-seal. None full file scan hashes are bounded to eight workers; mounted Plastic source scans remain serial and drained before later payload work. Mounted Plastic scans remain serial to preserve its single-revision proof/stream locality.
stages.completion: IndependentOfSnapshot result and collected record; does not assert compile success.
stages.costs: Source scan/hash, full payload preservation, result verification, full seals
stages.recovery: Drain admitted object workers before failure/cancellation returns. Seal mismatch preserves the prior task revision/result and all fixed intent/journal/object evidence. result.json alone is not collection completion; resume the same identity.

phaseOrder.work: Require stopped clients; compute complete journal seal.
Verify owner/mount/basis and Plastic isolation; read baseline manifest; scan mounted source once.
Fix task/request digest/baseline/result identities in collection.json.
Preserve unique full baseline objects; None local work uses up to 8 workers; recorded Plastic acquisition is serial.
Preserve unique full current-result objects with up to 8 local workers, after baseline workers drain.
Verify all distinct baseline/result objects with up to 8 workers.
Save result.json, then reverify independent records and every required object against candidate revision; injected verification readers stay sequential.
Return source revision/fingerprint/reference without advancing task ResultRevision or Snapshot.Result.
Require clean result and nonempty reference, compute complete post-seal, require equality with pre-seal.
Set ResultRevision and Snapshot.Result, then persist collected.

fileResultFlow.existingObjectWork: Reverify existing object; content-hash deduplication does not skip proof.
fileResultFlow.overlap: Only independent objects within an eligible phase overlap; phases join in order. Source scan and Plastic revision acquisition stay serial.
fileResultFlow.publicationBoundary: Provider result.json may exist before post-seal; only Runtime seal equality permits accepting the task revision/result.
fileResultFlow.laterInvocations: Fresh independent-result verification remains for release/apply.

stages.name: Apply Git result
stages.preconditions: Exact clean independent task result; clean original already on requested branch; project lock.
stages.work: Already-ancestor check or local guarded merge; verify clean original.
stages.completion: Integrated result state; Git command provides its own persistence semantics.
stages.costs: Git object/tree work and original changed-file writes
stages.recovery: Abort only own matching merge; no automatic original Editor operation or push.

stages.name: Plan original file application
stages.preconditions: Exact independently preserved result; target/basis/Plastic and stopped-original guards.
stages.work: Compare baseline/result/current original; select paths/companions; detect conflicts; digest.
stages.completion: Concrete fixed plan/digest; planning does not publish source files.
stages.costs: Current target scan/hash, plan and identity/lock observations
stages.recovery: Changed target needs a valid reviewed plan; no conflict override.

stages.name: Publish original file plan
stages.preconditions: Same plan, selection, identity; whole write-set and conditional NTFS checks.
stages.work: Persist intent; hash/write/flush owned stages; retire/publish per file; record progress and cleanup.
stages.completion: Completed matching intent; recoverable per-file effects, not all-files atomicity.
stages.costs: Payload reads/hashes/writes, stage flushes, per-step durable receipts
stages.recovery: Resume same intent/digest/selection; incomplete apply blocks collection/release/discard.

stages.name: Release preserving result
stages.preconditions: Independent result, no uncollected changes/dependent views, stopped owned app.
stages.work: Verify result; unmount/seal; unregister; reclaim delta; release task basis/ref/dependency; observe absence.
stages.completion: released only after exact absence/zero resources; result and evidence survive.
stages.costs: Seals/source checks, unmount/handle drain, inventory deletion, basis/ref removal
stages.recovery: reclaim-pending is incomplete; same task/home/result; no peer cleanup.

stages.name: Discard without creating result
stages.entry: workspace discard with intent and expected request digest
stages.preconditions: Matching identity/digest, provider support, no conflicting apply/release/compact or dependent views.
stages.work: Persist stop/unmount/source/delta/snapshot steps; seals and zero-resource proof; exact reclamation.
stages.completion: discarded after verified absence; no checkpoint or compile success needed.
stages.costs: Normal shutdown, full seals, unmount, exact deletion and dependency checks
stages.recovery: discard-reclaim-pending retries same intent; no rollback of already applied original or prior-result deletion.

stages.name: Restore common original basis
stages.frequency: explicitly after last dependent; absent if no managed basis
stages.preconditions: All dependents/readers gone; exact original Editor saved/stopped; exclusive reader protection.
stages.work: Resume an existing current plan before fresh policy; otherwise select unchanged, sparse, fixed-topology root-delta v1, eligible/preferred topology v1, then general v2. New routes are original Unity Library SJL4/bounded SJR2 only. Root-delta transfers once and applies same-path ranges/truncate/extend/new/deleted leaves. Topology fixes minimal units, stages deeper split children, installs shallow final/new directories, moves leaves, applies private ranges, then fully proves final content/identity/membership and metadata before authorized exact staged/journal reclaim. Root plan/intent/cursor zero precede root effects; each topology operation gets a durable cursor and new directories get identity receipts. Fresh preference T<F && O+N<=ceil(F/CursorBatchSize) uses the shared general 128-file constant; it never alters existing-intent recovery.
stages.completion: Ordinary original current contents proven restored; receipts/results retained.
stages.costs: Complete proofs, range-data flushes, new-file/directory ownership receipts, final metadata and exact reclaim remain. Root-delta/topology avoid per-survivor moves when carried by a root/subtree. Topology effect cursors are individually durable, unlike the general 128-file completion batching. Forest original/receipt directory maps freeze before at most eight full-hash workers and join on failure/cancel. Guard counts are structural floors, not elapsed guarantees; final component timing/resource disposition adopted A and guarded B2 after a successful full gate; whole-Unity timing is unqualified.
stages.recovery: Resume the same general v2, unchanged v2, sparse v1, root-delta v1 or topology v1 protocol without migration. Topology reconciles k/k+1 using actual native path/type/ID proof; inventory projection alone is not authority. Retain full final TreePins and staged membership protection. Preserve/refuse foreign/replaced/changed/unreceipted nodes. Exact-parent no-replace new-file/directory creation and topology child staging/install and type/path/ID rechecks contain empty-parent attrs-only reparse conversion, not universal prevention. Canonical plain control .GUID.tmp remnants are ignored/preserved, never adopted/deleted. Missing deleted stages require exact reclaim authorization; caller keeps borrowed original root, all workers join before disposal, peers keep basis managed.
